results.title: Paul Kengor: A timely moral message brought to us by ... toys
results.description: I devoted a well-spent two hours with my youngest son in a movie theater last Saturday afternoon. We sat together, father and son, to watch “Toy Story 5.” Yes, that’s “5.” Typically, I make it a mission to avoid any so-called film “franchise” after the sequel. I’ve made exceptions — “The Godfather,” “Rocky,” “Indiana Jones” — not all to my liking. Nonetheless, there I was.
